name: orthomcl-group-of-a-falciparum-protein
turns: Which ortholog group contains the Plasmodium falciparum 3D7 protein of gene PF3D7_1133400 (AMA1)?
rationale: A protein named by its gene is found among the proteins, then transformed to its group; the answer is one group, named by its id.

provenance.curatorNote: Protein to group through Transform Proteins to Groups.
